name: services/theses/users
description: Get theses-related information on multiple users. This is very similar to the user method, but work with multiple users.
brief_description: Get theses-related information on multiple users.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of user method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary: your user_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain an object with user-related thesis data, as defined in the user method.

For invalid user_ids (users which do not exist) null will be returned (instead of a dictionary).
